Hi, I am Jack Liu, a current UBC MDS student for the 2026/27 semester. I graduated in 2024 from UBC with a Bachelor’s of Science in Sustainable Agriculture. For the past year and half, I have been working as a receiver at Sungiven Foods (White Rock). I hope that through the UBC MDS program, I will be able to gain a comprehensive skillset of data analysis to pursue career as a data analyst in the future.

title: About
text:
Why Data Science
I became interested in Data Science toward the end of my bachelor’s degree. I have always enjoyed working with numbers, analyzing problems, and finding solutions that support better decision-making. During my work as a Receiver, I gained experience with data entry, inventory tracking, and records management. However, this made me realize that I wanted to do more than simply manage data. I wanted to use data to analyze problems and support decision-making, however I did not yet have the qualifications. This motivated me to enroll in UBC’s MDS program, which will allow me to develop the technical skills needed for a career in data analysis. The accelerated 10-month format also fits well with my goal of transitioning into the field quickly.

I am an avid fan of football, especially the English Premier League. My favorite team is Chelsea FC. I am also a huge foodie, and I enjoy exploring various restaurants in Vancouver with diverse cuisines. My favorite food is Donair.
